channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2002 as global bond rout gathers pace
item.description: Treasury yields were higher on Thursday amid a global sell-off in government debt.

item.title: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
item.description: Micron is up over 500% in the past year as the company benefits from soaring AI demand.

item.title: Walmart is using light-up digital shelf labels to help shoppers and employees find items
item.description: Walmart is rolling out a light-up shelf label feature connected to its app to help customers better find the items they're looking for.

item.title: SpaceX set to launch Google AI chips into orbit in push toward space-based data centers
item.description: SpaceX plans to launch Google tensor processing units into orbit on Planet Labs satellites.

item.title: Fed's Kashkari says inflation is 'still too high' even after softer-than-expected PCE data, labor market is 'pretty good'
item.description: Kashkari sat down with CNBC's Steve Liesman for an exclusive conversation Wednesday night.

item.title: This dollar store stock will get a boost from a shaky economy, Loop Capital says
item.description: Dollar Tree's shares should get a lift as consumers tighten their purse strings amid uncertain macroeconomic conditions, an analyst says.

item.title: South Korean President Lee pushes back on Alaska LNG project after Trump touts Seoul's participation
item.description: The U.S. announced plans for up to $200 billion in South Korean investment, though Seoul has yet to finalize the participation in the Alaska LNG project.

item.title: The U.S. just made it much easier for retail investors to access private markets
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission has approved new plans to open private markets up to retail investors.

item.title: Thursday, October 1, 2026: Jim Cramer discusses his next moves for the Investing Club
Racehorse market breaks records riding high on tax breaks, stock market gains
item.description: Keeneland's 2026 September Yearling Sale, the world's largest thoroughbred auction, grossed a record $536.7 million.

item.title: Trump’s AI lunch included every major tech company. Except Apple
item.description: Apple's absence from Trump's AI lunch raised eyebrows, but the company is known to look out for its own interests.

item.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom bans AI 'robo bosses' in landmark state law, reversing his earlier veto
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom has banned 'robo-bosses' from firing workers, the first U.S. state with such a law.

item.title: SEC proposes investor exam to expand private-market access — here's how it could work
item.description: The SEC proposed expanding accredited investor eligibility beyond traditional income and net worth thresholds, including through a new exam.

item.title: Japan's prime minister says her policies will boost confidence in the yen after U.S. intervention falls short
item.description: Japan's Prime Minister said her government's policies will lift confidence in the yen, following underwhelming success in prior efforts to boost the currency.

item.title: October by the numbers: A typically strong month with a scary reputation
item.description: Some of the biggest monthly declines have happened in October.

item.title: Broadcom to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to lease its chips, filing says
item.description: Anthropic's IPO prospectus reveals an extensive partnership with chip maker Broadcom that includes $42 billion lent to the AI lab to lease its chips.

item.title: AI is operating inside the healthcare billing system. Patients may already be paying the price
item.description: As AI codes billing inside hospitals, insurers say costs are being added to a bloated health care system. Blue Cross Blue Shield put the tab near $1 billion.

item.title: Oil prices rise as Chinese refiners reportedly ban October fuel exports; Brent crude near $100
item.description: It comes after a report that Chinese refiners suspended October fuel exports to protect domestic supplies.

item.title: Passengers and crew foil co-pilot's apparent attempt to crash FlyDubai flight to Israel
item.description: One of the pilots on a FlyDubai flight headed for Israel stabbed the second pilot, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Russia launches massive strikes on Ukraine’s energy grid, forcing power cuts ahead of winter
item.description: Seven people were killed in the attack and emergency power cuts were imposed in Kyiv and three other regions.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Thursday
item.description: Micron shares should be higher after that spectacular quarter.

item.title: Gen Z’s 'little treat’ economy is thriving. These financial products help you enjoy responsibly
item.description: Gen Z is spending on small indulgences even as finances stay tight. Here are four ways to budget for little treats more intentionally.

item.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Argon, its most advanced AI model
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon is Alphabet's most advanced model yet, with major coding, cybersecurity, and complex professional work improvements.

item.title: David Ellison names Ynon Kreiz co-CEO of Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: Paramount CEO David Ellison announced outgoing Mattel chief Ynon Kreiz will serve as the co-CEO of the anticipated combination of Paramount and WBD.

item.title: Bargain Britain lures foreign buyers as hostile takeovers surge
item.description: International capital is driving a surge in public takeovers in the G7’s fastest-growing economy.

item.title: Cramer says 'frozen' conditions are holding many stocks back. Here's what could change that
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said Wednesday that several key parts of the U.S. economy have effectively frozen.

item.title: MGM CEO leaves door open to People Inc. bid as casino dealmaking heats up
item.description: The Wall Street Journal reported MGM was exploring an offer for People Inc. after People Inc. withdrew its $48.30-per-share proposal to buy the rest of MGM.

item.title: Grindr expands beyond dating with $250 million telehealth acquisition of PurposeMed
item.description: Grindr is buying PrEP provider Freddie for $250 million, expanding into healthcare and seeking to make HIV prevention more accessible to its users.

item.title: Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey and Newt Gingrich to help Pentagon with warfare initiative, Hegseth says
item.description: Pete Hegseth, in remarks about the state of the military, announced a project led by two GOP-supporting tech executives to examine military capabilities.

item.title: AI race heats up as OpenAI flags alleged model-copying campaign
item.description: OpenAI says it identified an attempt to extract protected reasoning from its AI models, linking part of the activity with China’s Moonshot AI.
